AttributionLimits: The current pass records 225/267 correct positive images versus 219/267 previously; gained: maxicode-1/with-errors.png, maxicode-1/1.png, maxicode-1/MODE6.png, maxicode-1/MODE3.png, maxicode-1/mode4-mixed-sets.png, maxicode-1/MODE5.png; previously correct positive images lost: none. Paired negative completion is [29, 29, 30, 30]/31 currently and [22, 29, 30, 30]/31 previously. MaxiCode image scanning and its lossless carrier comparison presentation address the six formerly unsupported inputs. Original hints, payload oracles and per-image deadlines remain fixed. Default-family allowance distribution includes the added image family. Paired nineteen-image and unchanged retail costs retain every sample, failure and allocation loss. Supplemental PDF417 images and the six MaxiCode images have informed permanent regression fixtures; they are not an unseen holdout. Invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracles and undeclared QR encoding policies remain unchanged. Shared-host contention and budgets affect results. Multi-instance MaxiCode localization, mirrored MaxiCode lattices, stacked DataBar localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved. These finite workloads do not establish overall superiority.
